boundary: Acquisition finds and opens candidate information. Interpretation explains a supplied packet. Interpretation-only results cannot satisfy this acquisition gate.

before_dispatch: requested model/effort and observable resolved model identity
provider-item, search, open, wall-time, token and monetary limits
required facets and prior/reference canonical economic units
full case roster, metric names and grader source closure
sealing.ledger: Register every attempt before work. Finish once; retain failed and unknown outcomes. No quality-driven reruns or overwritten contracts. Changed source/policy/grader starts a new version.

resources.numeric_limits: Observed usage must be present and within each numeric cap; unknown cannot satisfy a numeric monetary/token limit.
resources.unobservable_limit: Freeze null only for an explicitly unobservable dimension; preserve unknown metrics and make no corresponding efficiency claim.
resources.counting: Count each search/open/find item and all failed/retried/fallback items. Cache/local attempts are separate. Batch adapter dispatches are not HTTP request counts.

required_run_evidence.bindings: execution_id, arm, config_sha256, question_sha256, baseline_sha256, cutoff, model_sha256, backend and cohort
required_run_evidence.search_receipt_refs: Nonempty actual host search traces, with request_ref, raw response_ref, timestamps, execution/backend binding and returned source-version hashes.
required_run_evidence.open_receipt_refs: Nonempty actual open/read traces with raw response bytes and source-version hashes; scored units must originate from an opened source.
required_run_evidence.cache_attempt_refs: Actual Cache attempt refs whenever cache was claimed or required for that arm. Ordinary baseline may declare no cache; absence cannot establish cache benefit.
required_run_evidence.exposure_ref: Host source/version screen before first worker exposure, including result titles/snippets/counts and body; unknown/future versions cannot enter worker context. Source raw/text hashes and max observed/available/modified/updated/version times are rechecked.
required_run_evidence.receipt_authentication_limit: The gate checks retained bytes, links and timing, not signatures. Trusted host capture and the sealed runner must create these receipts. Handwritten booleans or model prose are not execution evidence.

required_support: exact opened source-version reference and quote
first verified availability and provenance when known
economic_unit.deduplication: Canonicalize equivalent meanings before hashing. Rewording, sentence splitting, syndication, IR/newsroom mirrors and repeated citations do not create new units. Keep source versions and independent corroborating lineages separately; a revision is not automatically a new economic mechanism.
economic_unit.scope: A meter/launch/target is not paid adoption, actual recognized revenue or profit. Explicit gaps remain gaps. Source counts and supported-claim counts are not economic-unit breadth.

pooled_review.owner: Independent host-side reviewer after both immutable outputs exist
pooled_review.packet: Pool A union B candidates under neutral IDs, remove arm labels, prompts, process diagnostics and identifying file paths; provide exact sources and unchanged rubric. Host retains mapping and run refs separately.
pooled_review.incomplete_reference: Reference coverage is bounded. Valid additions outside the frozen reference can count after the same blind review; log additions without changing old gold or rubric.
pooled_review.unknowns: All pooled candidates must be accounted for. Unjudged items in either arm block an improvement claim for both. Invalid/future evidence blocks grading rather than becoming novel information.
pooled_review.blindness_limit: Packet separation and a distinct reviewer identity are not OS isolation or human-calibrated ground truth; disclose residual same-family and shared-filesystem risks.

metrics: unique supported new canonical units versus prior baseline
calls, latency, tokens and cost with unknowns
forbidden_shortcuts: 0-to-2 novelty correctness rubric used as acquisition quantity
supported sentence count used as unique economic information
retrieval timestamp used as original publication time
old publication date used to authenticate a newer body
same pinned packet with zero acquisitions passed as acquisition A/B

cohorts.cold: No prior cache preload. Primary information richness and coverage comparison.
cohorts.warm_cache: Separate repeated-query efficiency comparison; retained source dates cannot become newer.
cohorts.fault: Separate controlled retry/fallback test; injected failure is not a natural outage or freshness gain.

decision: First require valid controls, actual acquisition traces, complete eligible pooled review and no critical error. Report A-minus-B unique-new/reference/facet/precision/time/resource differences without a weighted ceiling score. Accept only the observed scoped advantage with no material integrity or coverage regression; ties, tradeoffs and inconclusive results are valid. One NOW workload is not population superiority, significance, calibrated label accuracy or investment alpha.
